tools.name: convoy_status
tools.description: Your convoy status: per-agent states, sequence, at-risk list, meter.

tools.name: convoy_screen
tools.description: Run the metadata sensitivity screen; returns convoy order, most fragile first. Ordering only - never an equivalence result.

tools.name: convoy_readiness
tools.description: Readiness verdict for one agent (inventory + screen). First verdict free once per operator; paid verdicts settle over x402 on POST /readiness.

tools.name: convoy_port
tools.description: Port one agent's configuration to the successor model.

tools.name: convoy_cutover
tools.description: Cut over an agent that passed its equivalence gate. Held or ungated agents are refused.

tools.name: convoy_disposition
tools.description: Disposition a held agent: pin-and-pay, retire, or accept-and-flag (ack bound to the exact failing set).
